fakeApp:
#!/bin/sh
for a in "$@"; do printf '%s\n' "$a" >> "$FAKE_APP_LOG.part"; done
edit=; wait=
for a in "$@"; do
  case "$a" in
    --edit=*) edit=${a#--edit=} ;;
    --wait=*) wait=${a#--wait=} ;;
  esac
done
if [ -n "$wait" ]; then printf 'edited by the app\n' > "$edit"; rm -f "$wait"; fi
mv "$FAKE_APP_LOG.part" "$FAKE_APP_LOG"

# gitcito bash completion — add to ~/.bashrc:
#   eval "$(gitcito completions bash)"
_gitcito() {
  local cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
  if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 1 ]; then
    COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "absorb bisect blame changelog chat ci clean commit-check completions config conflicts diff doctor editor export gitflow graph help history hooks insights lfs maintenance objects open purge reflog repos search settings show snapshots sparse stack stash status subtree terminal time-machine timelapse todos" -- "$cur") )
  else
    COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -d -- "$cur") )
  fi
}
complete -F _gitcito gitcito

# gitcito zsh completion — add to ~/.zshrc:
#   eval "$(gitcito completions zsh)"
_gitcito() {
  if (( CURRENT == 2 )); then
    compadd absorb bisect blame changelog chat ci clean commit-check completions config conflicts diff doctor editor export gitflow graph help history hooks insights lfs maintenance objects open purge reflog repos search settings show snapshots sparse stack stash status subtree terminal time-machine timelapse todos
  else
    _files -/
  fi
}
compdef _gitcito gitcito

# gitcito fish completion — write to ~/.config/fish/completions/gitcito.fish:
#   gitcito completions fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/gitcito.fish
complete -c gitcito -f
complete -c gitcito -n "__fish_use_subcommand" -a "absorb bisect blame changelog chat ci clean commit-check completions config conflicts diff doctor editor export gitflow graph help history hooks insights lfs maintenance objects open purge reflog repos search settings show snapshots sparse stack stash status subtree terminal time-machine timelapse todos"
complete -c gitcito -n "not __fish_use_subcommand" -a "(__fish_complete_directories)"
